Name: Wizard Enhanced
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately!

Note: This mod works as a standalone or can be installed alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]![/b][/size]

[size=4]What This Mod Does:[/size]

- Edits the Wizard Tower to give him a proper bedroom. Even masters of the Elementals need their rest!
- Gives him a schedule. He'll make potions, read his books, meditate. Even go outside sometimes. He'll also visit the Bookseller if he's in town (with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] installed) and set up the maze for Spirit's Eve (thanks Romanceable Rasmodius for the open perms, which supplied the base schedule and dialogue strings).
- Edits Romanceable Rasmodius 8 heart event to be compatible with the new Tower map.
- All changes are Rasmodia compatible.

[size=4]What This Mod Does NOT Do:[/size]

- Give him additional dialogue (consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30959]Haywrites Narrative Overhaul[/url])
- Give him additional events/heart events (consider Romanceable Rasmodius, even if you don't plan to romance him)
- Edit any of his character data
- Add him to festivals he is missing from
- Allow him to visit Ginger Island
- Add to or edit his marriage schedule if he has one (I might change my mind on this later, idk yet)

[size=5]Mod Compatibility:[/size]

Due to the variety of mods out there, I can't guarantee compatibility for other mods that edit the Wizard Tower or his schedule, or add/edit events that take place within the Wizard Tower. Events that take place within the main area should be fine.

I've created a list below of mods that are confirmed compatible.

By default, this mod is incompatible with SVE and SVE RomRas variants.

[b]Mod authors who want to create a compatibility patch in their mod to work with mine are completely welcome to do so! No need to ask me for permission![/b]

[size=4]Confirmed Compatible:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Rasmodia[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion[/url]

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Wizard Tower Map[/b]: Edits the Wizard Tower map to add a bedroom and move the library area below the main room. This option will override map edits added by other mods and possibly conflict with modded cutscenes. Not compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded! (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Schedule[/b]: Gives the Wizard a schedule. This option will override his schedule added by other mods, such as Romanceable Rasmodius. This does nothing if Wizard Tower Map is set to False. (True, False) Defaults True

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (and optionally [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]).
- Copy [CP] Wizard Enhanced into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
